name: driver-drowsiness-detection
description: Root package for Driver Drowsiness Detection project

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.start: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm start --prefix backend"
